verdict.rationale: Marlin is documented as an autonomous research agent that takes a topic, gathers web information and writes a long strategy report with slides. The evidence never describes systematic screening of a paper corpus, user-defined inclusion or exclusion criteria, or structured data extraction applied consistently across many papers. Autonomous topic research and a 'review-paper level depth' testimonial are adjacent to the story, not the screening-and-extraction capability it asks for.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can run a systematic screening and extraction workflow across many papers with consistent criteria
